scope: Information and completion rules of each comparison policy. Placeholders are filled from code: {tau} is the certificate floor of cm_experiments.budget.Certificate, {ensemble_grid} the registered ensemble sizes of the full configurations. 'arm' links a row to its identifier in cm_experiments.protocol.ARMS and 'implementation' to the module that executes it; both are checked by the generator.

open_loop.information: registered schedule; initial input where specified
open_loop.completion: explicit ending state or remaining nominal sites; tuned on development data

ensemble.completion: ensemble size raised to the ceiling on the registered grid E ∈ {ensemble_grid}; fractional sizes are not executable

predictor.information: initial graph and features; capacity matched to the critic
predictor.completion: predicts the complete supported sequence once, trained on development-oracle sequences

distillation.information: initial graph and features; development feedback trajectories as targets
distillation.completion: no feedback at evaluation; student prediction and full execution charged

mpc_ol.completion: lookahead H at site 0, then the declared tail

replanning.information: initial input, executed actions and model-predicted states
replanning.completion: re-solves the objective at every site with the same model calls as MPC-RH; never assimilates measurements

feedback.completion: registered profiles; cost of sensing and search charged

budget.information: cheap measurements every site; Lean or Full profile on trigger
budget.completion: certificate of main Proposition 9 with τ = {tau}; reserved comparator restart; late abort to q_C

oracle.information: stored feedback sequence or label-informed search
oracle.completion: exact execution check; never a deployable competitor
